name: Intuit TurboTax
description:
Get fast federal tax estimates and discover filing options with Intuit TurboTax-powered tools. Start with a simple tax estimator that guides you through the info you need and see your refund or amount owed as you go. When you're ready for expert help, connect with trusted tax pros. Confident tax filing starts here.

By connecting, you agree to the Intuit TurboTax [Terms of Service](https://www.intuit.com/legal/terms/en-us/turbotax/online-license/) and acknowledge Intuit's [Global Privacy Statement](https://www.intuit.com/privacy/statement/).

_published_faq.name: How do I add Intuit TurboTax to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Intuit TurboTax to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ai-inc.turbotax.intuit.com/358A1C1B-F73B-46A7-B130-4B14916E6843/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Intuit TurboTax MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Intuit TurboTax provides these MCP tools: tax_filing_options, tax_estimate, and expert_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Intuit TurboTax?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Intuit TurboTax in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Intuit TurboTax MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Intuit TurboTax requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Intuit TurboTax is developed by Intuit. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
